# Lab 26.1: Partner Centre Tour

## What We Are Going to Do
Explore Partner Centre, find a partner tool by category, and start a free trial connection to your project.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open Partner Centre.** Click **Partner Centre** at the bottom of the BigQuery menu.

2. **[Console] Browse categories.** Look at data integration (ELT), BI and visualisation, data quality, governance, and machine learning partners. Each card shows what the tool does with BigQuery.

3. **[Console] Connect a partner.** Pick a partner with a free trial, click **Connect**, and follow the steps. Partner Centre usually creates a service account and a dataset for the partner, and shows exactly which roles are granted.

4. **[CLI] Check what was created.**

5. **[Console] Remove the connection** when you finish the trial, and delete any service account it created.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Partner Centre | Catalogue of BigQuery-integrated tools |
| Connect | Guided setup with clear permissions |
| Created resources | Service account and dataset |
| Clean-up | Remove after the trial |
